@graph.description: Follow a Help Scout setup guide for inboxes, email forwarding, users, Docs, Beacon, workflows, SLAs and Scout, with checks for common setup errors today.

itemListElement.name: How to Use Help Scout: Setup and Workflows

mainEntity.name: How do I start using Help Scout?

acceptedAnswer.text: Create one Inbox, connect and test the support email, invite the first teammates and publish a small Docs site. Add Beacon and workflows after the basic reply path works.

mainEntity.name: Can Help Scout import data from another help desk?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Its official import guide lists several supported sources, including Freshdesk and Zendesk. It does not import every user setting, knowledge base article, saved reply, automation or custom field.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a separate Inbox for every topic?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Create a separate inbox when another team owns the response or needs a different service target. Use tags and views when the same team handles the work.

mainEntity.name: Should I enable the AI agent on day one?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not before the Docs content and handoff rules are ready. Test common, missing and account-specific questions first, then track resolutions and escalations.
